record.question: Which one is a "text editor" for Microsoft Windows?
record.explanation: Answer A: Notepad. Notepad is the standard Windows plain-text editor. WordPad is a richer word-processing application, while Notebook and Excel are not the named Windows text editor. The stem uses the conventional classroom distinction. Reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/help-in-notepad Independently reviewed worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
